notes.title: Perils of Man update and Polish version
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce Polish interface and subtitles have been added to Perils of Man for Windows and Mac!

We have also improved the following game-play elements: 

- Hot spots are easier to identify and to click on. 
- Risk objects are easier to identify with the Risk Atlas. 
- Inventory items that are obsolete will automatically be removed from the inventory. 
- Save game system has been revamped to be more stable.
- Many other stability and convenient fixes.

notes.title: Polish version added for Windows and Mac
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce Polish interface and subtitles have been added to Perils of Man! You can select the Polish language under Perils of Man Properties > Languages in your Steam Library or in-game under settings. 

We also felt like Perils of Man has been a struggle for some players. Ex: inaccurate Hot Spots and Risk Object detection. Therefore, we have improved the following game elements: 

- Hot spots are easier to identify and to click on. 
- Risk objects are easier to identify with the Risk Atlas. 
- Inventory items that are obsolete will automatically be removed from the inventory. 
- Save game system has been revamped to be more stable. 
- Other stability and convenient fixes.

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
- Dialog options will now be displayed with subtitles set off.
- Item interactions and descriptions will now be displayed with subtitles set off.
- Localization fix for cinematics: will now play the right subtitles and/or audio depending on your settings.
- Resolved an issue where items got stuck in the inventory.

Have fun!
